messages.content:
<document id=DOC_posting_odd_headers>
What you will need on day one.
1. Python.
2. SQL.

What would make you stand out.
3. Grafana.
4. Technical writing.
</document>

The posting above groups its requirements under headers. Say for each
header whether the requirements under it are mandatory or optional, and
say what in the header told you.

response.text:
**“What you will need on day one.” — mandatory.**  
“Will need” states a requirement, and “on day one” means it must already be in place when you start.

**“What would make you stand out.” — optional.**  
“Would make you stand out” describes an advantage over other candidates, not something you must have.
